subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Charles Ponzi: The Original Scheme
description: A 60-second lesson on Charles Ponzi: The Original Scheme.

hook.text: In 1920, Charles Ponzi promised 50% returns in 45 days. Thousands of Bostonians gave him their savings.

buildup.text: Ponzi's scheme used international reply coupons as cover, but no actual arbitrage ever happened.

discovery.text: He collected $20 million (about $300 million today) in eight months before the scheme collapsed.

twist.text: Ponzi knew the math was impossible from the start. He planned to take the money and run to Italy.

climax.text: Ponzi gave his name to every scheme since. A century later, the trick still works on new victims.

punchline.text: 50% returns in 45 days. The math was always impossible.

quiz.question: What did Charles Ponzi claim to use for his returns?
